title: Retraction after finite étale reduction
statement: Let ℓ be a prime number and let F_ℓ = ℤ/ℓℤ, the field with ℓ elements. In Lean the coefficient field is its universe lift ULift (ZMod ℓ), which has the same field operations. Let U be irreducible, let G be a finite locally constant sheaf of F_ℓ-vector spaces on U, and let v : V ⟶ U be finite étale with V connected. If every geometric fibre of v has cardinality d and ℓ does not divide d, then the unit G ⟶ v_*v^*G of the étale pullback/direct-image adjunction has a retraction. Conventions: irreducibility [def-weil-irreducible-components], connectedness [def-weil-connected-scheme], small étale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], coefficient-module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], finite étale morphisms [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], pullback [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], and geometric points [def-weil-geometric-point]. Direct image is as in [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. Geometric-fibre cardinality counts lifts [def-weil-pbc-geometric-fibre]; for finite étale morphisms over a separably closed field these correspond to the points of the fibre scheme.

source.place: Section 03SH (section-trace-method), characterization of trace and the restriction/trace composite immediately after Definition 03SE (definition-trace-map)

proof.text: Apply the coefficient-linear trace degree theorem to R = ULift (ZMod ℓ), v, G and the prescribed geometric-fibre cardinality d, obtaining t with η_G ≫ t = (d : R) • id_G. This step does not use invertibility of d.

The nondivisibility hypothesis and ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff show that (d : ZMod ℓ) is nonzero. The prime hypothesis supplies its field structure. Consequently its inverse times itself is one; ULift.ext lifts this scalar equality. Set r = (d : R)⁻¹ • t. By linearity of composition and smul_smul, η_G ≫ r = ((d : R)⁻¹ * (d : R)) • id_G = id_G.

proof_origin.place: B2 stage 3: coefficient-linear trace degree followed by inverse-scalar normalization, following Section 03SH after Definition 03SE

blueprint_sketch.statement:
For irreducible $U$ and finite locally constant $G$ of
$\mathbf F_\ell$-vector spaces, there is a finite etale
$v:V\to U$ of degree prime to $\ell$ such that $v^{-1}G$ has a filtration by
constant $\mathbf F_\ell$-sheaves, and $G$ is a direct summand of
$v_*v^{-1}G$.
blueprint_sketch.proof:
Choose a geometric point $\bar u$ of $U$. The locally constant sheaf gives
a representation

$$
\rho:\pi_1(U,\bar u)\longrightarrow
\operatorname{GL}_{\mathbf F_\ell}(G_{\bar u})
$$

with finite image $Q$. If $H\subseteq Q$ is an $\ell$-Sylow subgroup, the
inverse image $\rho^{-1}(H)$ defines a connected finite etale cover
$v:V\to U$ of degree $d=[Q:H]$, which is prime to $\ell$. On $V$, the
monodromy factors through $H$.

The representation filtration gives
$0=V_0\subset V_1\subset\cdots\subset V_m=G_{\bar u}$ with
$V_a/V_{a-1}\cong\mathbf F_\ell$ and trivial $H$-action. Passing from
$H$-modules to locally constant sheaves gives, for every $a$, the explicit
short exact sequence

$$
0\longrightarrow G_{a-1}\longrightarrow G_a\longrightarrow
\underline{\mathbf F_\ell}_V\longrightarrow0,
\qquad G_m=v^{-1}G.
$$

All inclusions, quotient maps, and connecting maps commute with extension of
the algebraically closed ground field.

The adjunction unit and the fibrewise sum are

$$
\eta:G\longrightarrow v_*v^{-1}G,\qquad
\operatorname{tr}:v_*v^{-1}G\longrightarrow G.
$$

At a geometric stalk, $\eta(s)=(s,\ldots,s)$ in the direct sum indexed by
the $d$ points of the fibre, while
$\operatorname{tr}(s_1,\ldots,s_d)=\sum_as_a$. Consequently
$\operatorname{tr}\circ\eta=d\,\operatorname{id}_G$. Multiplication by
$d^{-1}\in\mathbf F_\ell$ defines
$r=d^{-1}\operatorname{tr}$ with $r\eta=\operatorname{id}_G$.
The stalk formulas are preserved by base change, so the direct-summand
decomposition and every filtration exact sequence are compatible with the
cohomology comparison maps.

lean.statement:
theorem Scheme.IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf.exists_finite_etale_retraction
    {U V : Scheme.{u}} [IrreducibleSpace U] (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    (G : Sheaf U.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod ℓ))))
    [IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf G] (v : V ⟶ U) [IsFinite v] [Etale v]
    [ConnectedSpace V] (d : ℕ) (hd : ¬ ℓ ∣ d)
    (hdeg : ∀ (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω] (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ U),
      Nat.card (v.GeometricFiber s) = d) :
    ∃ r : (v)_*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod ℓ))].obj
          ((v)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod ℓ))].obj G) ⟶ G,
        (Etale.upperStarLowerStarAdjunction
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod ℓ))) v).unit.app G ≫ r = 𝟙 G
